title: Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru
native_title: 心霊呪殺師 太郎丸
overview:
Psychic action starring Taroumaru, the beautiful curse-killer who has descended upon the demon city of Great Edo!

Psychic warriors Taroumaru and Enkai battle the demons and monsters of a supernatural Edo to rescue a kidnapped girl. This side-scrolling action game sets hand-drawn characters against 3D backgrounds that turn with the action, and the whole adventure flows as one continuous journey through four acts.

Nearby enemies are targeted automatically, and you can switch targets to hit a boss's weak spots. Fire quick bursts of psychic energy or charge up a stronger blast, raise a spirit shield to push enemies back and absorb shots, and hypnotize certain foes into fighting at your side - or blow them up to damage everything on screen.

- 24 creatures of darkness, including giant spiders and frogs
- Purify vengeful spirits with your chants
- A second player can join in at any time for co-op play

魔都大江戸に降臨した美貌の呪殺師、太郎丸による超能力活劇!
